lines.text: "title": "[Cursor] Add PostHog for field Web Vitals / INP",

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text:
"body": "## Summary

Landing Lighthouse is a cold-load lab for `/`. Players spend the session on `/game/$code` (steal, place, timeline). We need field INP, not another synthetic homepage score.

PostHog's free cloud plan includes 1M events/month. `$web_vitals` covers LCP, INP, CLS, FCP as normal events (~30% of pageviews). That is enough for Codetail traffic and gives a real dashboard without a paid RUM vendor.

Netlify RUM is Pro-only. CrUX / Search Console will not see per-game URLs and lag by ~28 days.

## Scope

- PostHog JS on production (not e2e / local unless flagged)
- Enable web vitals capture; keep product autocapture off unless we decide we want it
- Report **route templates** (`/game/$code`), never raw join codes
- Filter or sample so `$web_vitals` does not drown the free quota if we later add more events

Nice-to-have: INP grouped by path so player vs landing vs host/TV are visible.

## Out of scope

- Session replay (free quota is tiny; skip)
- Cloudflare beacon / DIY `web-vitals` → Convex (alternatives if PostHog is too heavy)
- Host/TV YouTube iframe metrics

## Test plan

- [ ] Production pageviews show `$web_vitals` with INP
- [ ] `/game/$code` appears as a template, not individual codes
- [ ] No PostHog in Playwright / Docker e2e
- [ ] Clerk / session tokens never sent as properties

Posted by Cursor Grok 4.6",
